feeSource.title: Portal reported no fees
feeSource.what: This booking arrived from the portal without a fee breakdown. The statement therefore charges no cleaning, utility or pet fee: what the portal did not report, the guest did not pay. The guest price is consequently lower than the amount stored for this property.
feeSource.channexImport: The booking was fetched retroactively when the channel was connected. According to the portal intermediary, such bookings contain no extras and no cleaning fees — this cannot be retrieved later. If the fee is to be billed, add it as a line item on the booking.
feeSource.portalReportsNone: The portal does not list the fee as a separate line item on this booking. With Booking.com this depends on the property configuration (Property → Policies → Additional fees) and on the date from which the fee applies there: a fee introduced later is rightly missing on older bookings.
feeSource.noPayload: There is no portal message for this booking (import of existing data). Without it, there is no way to determine which fees the guest paid.
feeSource.csvImport: The booking originates from the CSV inventory import. The imported amount is the guest price of the portal including all fees; a breakdown of individual fees is not available and could not be derived from the portal data. Therefore, the billing does not apply any fees from the property master data — they are already included in the amount, but their exact value is not documented.
feeSource.csvResolvedTitle: Fees derived from the portal amount
feeSource.csvResolved: The booking originates from the CSV inventory import; the portal did not provide a breakdown. The fees were derived from the difference between the imported total price and the nightly rates transmitted by the portal and named via the property master data. Accommodation plus fees exactly equal the total price.
feeSource.stammdatenPortalTitle: Fees added from property master data
feeSource.stammdatenPortal: The portal did not provide a fee breakdown for this booking: Bookings that the portal aggregator retrieved after connecting the channel do not include extras and cleaning fees; an inventory import from a file only contains the total price. The fees were therefore set as stored for the property: cleaning per stay, resort per night, pet only if a pet is booked.
feeSource.portalBelegt: Occupied: The difference between the total portal price and the nightly rates transmitted by the portal exactly matches these fees.
feeSource.portalImBetrag: Included in portal amount: The total portal price already includes the fees; they have been deducted, the guest price remains the portal amount.
feeSource.portalObendrauf: In addition to portal amount: The transmitted amount is the pure nightly sum; fees are added to this to make up the guest price.

rental.noFeeItems: No fees or additional services on this booking.

posten.guestPrice: Guest price according to portal (incl. fees, excl. additional services)

info.basis: Determines when a booking falls within the period: with Check-in by the arrival day, with Check-out by the departure day. A booking spanning the turn of the month lands in one month or the other depending on your choice.
info.statuses: Only bookings with one of the selected statuses are settled. The default is confirmed and completed bookings — cancelled ones normally do not belong in a payout.
info.channel: How this booking was made: via a portal like Booking.com or Airbnb, our myBestDays marketplace, the property's own website, or directly (phone, email, on-site).
info.portalDeduction: What the portal retains before the money reaches the property – its commission and, if it collects the money, its payment fee. For bookings made via the property's own website or directly, this is 0, as there is no portal involved.
info.commission: The property's commission for managing the accommodation. It is calculated on the amount remaining after the portal deduction – and applies to EVERY booking, even those made via the property's own website.
info.flatFee: A fixed amount from the management contract, for example, for utilities. Depending on the agreement, it is deducted before or after the commission.
info.ownerShare: What remains for the owner at the end: guest price minus portal deduction, minus commission, minus flat fee, plus the fees that belong to them. In the case of co-ownership, additionally multiplied by their share.
info.ownershipShare: This owner's share of the property. 100% means sole ownership. If a house belongs to several people, each receives their own statement for their share – the shares together add up to 100%.
info.properties: Which properties this statement covers. By default, all properties of the owner are included — the statement then shows what each property is entitled to, and the preview and download additionally provide an extract for each property. Select a single property to settle only for that one. Each property can only be in one finalized statement per period — a booking is never paid out twice.
info.language: The receipt is created in this language — texts, numbers and date. Pre-filled from the owner's language, otherwise from the business's. After finalizing, it is fixed; the receipt remains as it was issued.
info.headerFromMaster: Updates name, address, email, phone and tax number of owner and business from the master data. Invoice number and notes of this receipt remain.
info.listingPayout: What this property is entitled to in the period: the owner's shares of its bookings plus the billing and recurring items associated with this property. Items not related to a property are only included in the total.

seiten.noindexBeitrag: Keep this post out of search engines
seiten.noindexBeitragHinweis: The post stays reachable at its address but is not indexed and is not in the sitemap.

erweitert.rechtHinweis: Notices your visitors see. The texts themselves live on your own pages.

blog.hinweis: What applies to the whole blog: its name, the navigation under every post and the RSS feed. Date, author and tags live with the individual post.
blog.name: Blog name
blog.nameHinweis: The heading of the post list and the title of the “Posts” section. Left empty, it says “Blog” in the guest’s language.
blog.navigationHinweis: Every post ends with links to its neighbours. The order is the publish date and cannot be changed.
blog.rssHinweis: Through the feed, returning guests and local portals follow the blog without visiting it.

blog.rssTextHinweis: One sentence about what the blog is about. Left empty, the website description applies.
blog.rssBildHinweis: Some readers show it next to the blog name.
blog.rssAdresse: The feed address is your website address with “/blog/rss.xml” at the end.
blog.importHinweis: Takes posts from another blog’s RSS feed — 300 at most in one go. They arrive as drafts and go live only when you release them. A second import creates no duplicates.
blog.importErgebnis: {angelegt} posts created, {uebersprungen} skipped, {gefunden} found in the feed.

abschnitte.buttonHinweis: A single button with a destination.
abschnitte.heroHinweis: Large image with heading and button.
abschnitte.imageHinweis: A single image with a caption.
abschnitte.propertiesGridHinweis: Properties in a grid, with real prices if they are switched on.
abschnitte.richTextHinweis: Formatted text with headings and lists.
abschnitte.searchHinweis: Search bar with dates and guest count.
abschnitte.faqHinweis: Expandable questions. With structured data they also appear in search results.
abschnitte.mapHinweis: Shows the location. Without an address, the one from the company profile is used.
abschnitte.testimonialsHinweis: Quotes you type in yourself. There is a separate section for real reviews.
abschnitte.featuresHinweis: What you offer — icon, heading, text in columns.
abschnitte.formHinweis: A form that guests fill in. The enquiries land in the “Enquiries” tab.
abschnitte.postsHinweis: Shows the newest blog posts. The blog itself lives at /blog.
abschnitte.accordionHinweis: A clickable title with the text appearing underneath. For questions and answers, use the FAQ section.
abschnitte.tabsHinweis: Multiple pieces of content in one space. On phones these turn into an accordion.
abschnitte.countdownHinweis: Counts down to a point in time — for an offer, an event, or the start of the season.
abschnitte.tableHinweis: Rows and columns of text. Content from Excel or Google Sheets can be pasted in directly.
abschnitte.listHinweis: Entries with an image, text and a link — stacked, as tiles, or numbered.
abschnitte.fileHinweis: Documents to download. Anyone who knows the address can open them without logging in.
abschnitte.copyrightHinweis: The © symbol with the current year, which updates itself automatically.
abschnitte.breadcrumbsHinweis: Shows the path from the homepage to here. Only useful on subpages.
abschnitte.searchPostsHinweis: A search field for the blog. It searches post titles.
abschnitte.mediaSliderHinweis: Images or videos as slides, with text and a button on them. 25 slides at most.
abschnitte.videoHinweis: A video from YouTube, Vimeo, or Dailymotion. Your own video files are not uploaded.
abschnitte.audioHinweis: A recording from SoundCloud or Mixcloud, for example a podcast about the region.
abschnitte.beforeAfterHinweis: Two images with a slider between them — for a renovation.
abschnitte.shapeHinweis: A shape with short text: an award, a special price, a note.
abschnitte.propertyBookFormHinweis: Dates, guests and the buttons to book or enquire.
abschnitte.propertyGalleryHinweis: The property's photos, maintained on the property itself.
abschnitte.propertyAmenitiesHinweis: The property's features, maintained on the property itself.
abschnitte.propertyMapHinweis: The map showing where the property is.
abschnitte.clickToCallHinweis: A button that dials the number.
abschnitte.clickToEmailHinweis: A button that opens the mail app.
abschnitte.socialIconsHinweis: Displays the networks from the company profile as a series of icons.
abschnitte.shareButtonHinweis: Allows guests to share this page on social networks.
abschnitte.whatsappChatHinweis: Floating button that opens a WhatsApp chat.
abschnitte.rssFeedHinweis: Displays the latest entries from an external RSS/Atom feed.
abschnitte.facebookFeedHinweis: Embeds the timeline of a Facebook page.
abschnitte.htmlWidgetHinweis: Custom HTML markup, cleaned upon saving.
abschnitte.checkoutFormHinweis: The path to payment: contact details, payment method, confirmation. Without this component, no one can book.
abschnitte.checkoutSummaryHinweis: What is booked: property, period, price breakdown. The server calculates the amounts.
abschnitte.checkoutResultHinweis: The text after payment - successful, pending, or failed. The payment service reports the result itself.
abschnitte.postListHinweis: The complete post overview with pagination. For a teaser on another page, there is the Posts component.
abschnitte.collectionListHinweis: The entries of a collection as cards, list or grid.
abschnitte.collectionDetailHinweis: The fields of a single entry. Belongs on the collection's detail page.

widgets.codeHinweis: Paste this code into the other page. It stays valid even as we keep developing our software.
widgets.hinweis: A search or booking field for ANOTHER website. Copy the code and paste it where the field should appear.
widgets.keineDomain: A widget needs your own domain: only that works reliably on another page. Connect it under Settings → Address.
widgets.kopierenFehler: Copying is not possible — please select it by hand.
widgets.neuesFensterHinweis: Off: your website replaces the other page in the same window.
widgets.spracheHinweis: The language the field appears in on the other page.

typBeschreibung.buchen: Dates and number of guests — leads to the property list on your website, without a destination field.
typBeschreibung.suche: Destination, dates and number of guests — leads to the property list on your website.

felder.titelHinweis: Shows in the browser tab and as the headline in the search result. Aim for about 60 characters — after that Google cuts it off.
felder.beschreibungHinweis: The text below the title in the search result. It does not affect the ranking, but it does affect whether people click.
felder.keywordsHinweis: Comma-separated. Google and Bing no longer use them — only smaller directories do.
felder.canonicalHinweis: Only needed when the same content is reachable under two addresses. Empty means: this page is the original.

uebersicht.hinweis: The settings here apply to the whole website. They take effect on every page that has none of its own — the actual work happens under “Pages”.
uebersicht.metaHinweis: Fallback for all pages without their own entry. If the same text appears everywhere, search engines read that as a lack of structure.
uebersicht.noindexHinweis: Keeps the whole website out of the search index. For a site under construction — switch it off again after launch, otherwise it will never be found.
uebersicht.noindexWarnung: While this switch is on, the robots.txt returns “Disallow: /” and there is no sitemap.
uebersicht.tempoHinweis: Google takes loading time into account. Both switches take effect on the website immediately.
uebersicht.lazyHinweis: Speeds up the first render. With a large image right at the top of the page it can slow the display down — switch it off in that case.
uebersicht.systemschrift: Show the system font until your own has loaded
uebersicht.systemschriftHinweis: The text is readable straight away, but the page visibly switches font.
uebersicht.dateienHinweis: These three files are generated automatically from the settings above. The sitemap.xml belongs in Google Search Console — that is the step which speeds up being indexed.

datei.sitemap: All addresses of the website with the date of their last change.
datei.robots: What may be crawled and where the sitemap is located.
datei.llms: A short version of the website for answer engines such as ChatGPT or Perplexity.

uebersicht.keineDomain: No own domain connected yet. The three files are generated as soon as the website runs under its own address.

seiten.hinweis: Every page needs its own title and its own description. This is the single biggest lever there is — this is where you see what is missing.
seiten.alleGepflegt: All pages have a title and a description.
seiten.offeneLuecken: {anzahl} pages without a title or description.
seiten.noindexHinweis: The page stays reachable at its address but does not appear in search results.

schema.hinweis: This is how a search engine understands that a price is a price and an address is an address. Only then do stars, prices and opening hours appear in the search result.
schema.organizationHinweis: Name, address, phone and email from the company profile.
schema.lodgingHinweis: Per property page: type of accommodation, amenities and the current daily price.
schema.breadcrumbsHinweis: Shows in the search result where the page sits within the website.
schema.faqHinweis: Only on pages with a question-and-answer section.
schema.quelleHinweis: All data comes from the company profile and the property records — nothing is entered twice here. If a schema is missing, the address in the profile is usually missing as well.

messung.hinweis: Visitor numbers via Google. One field for all four IDs — Google recognises which product is meant from the prefix.
messung.kennungHinweis: Analytics (G-), legacy (UA-), Google Ads (AW-) or Campaign Manager (DC-).
messung.kennungFormat: For example G-ABCD123456. Found in Google Analytics under Admin → Data streams.
messung.kennungFehler: The ID must begin with G-, UA-, AW- or DC-.
messung.zustimmungHinweis: The script loads but only measures after the visitor has consented. Until then it sets no Cookies.
messung.zustimmungAktiv: The Cookie notice is active. Measurement only starts after the visitor clicks.
messung.zustimmungFehlt: Without a Cookie notice, measurement starts immediately. In the EU that requires consent.

weiterleitungen.hinweis: Point old addresses to new ones. Needed when moving from another website — without a redirect, visitors from Google and from newsletters land on an error page.
weiterleitungen.nurPfad: Only the path will be saved:
weiterleitungen.csvFormat: Two columns: old address, new target. At most 200 rows.
weiterleitungen.dateiZuGross: The file is too large (200 KB maximum).
weiterleitungen.dateiLeer: No valid row was found in the file.
weiterleitungen.vorrangHinweis: A redirect only takes effect when there is no page at the old address. An existing page always takes precedence.

pruefung.hinweis: We check what we can check. Whether a page is found well is decided by Google — not by this list.
pruefung.nichtsVeroeffentlicht: No page published yet — there is nothing to check.
pruefung.allesGepflegt: Everything we can check is in order.
pruefung.allesGepflegtHinweis: {anzahl} published pages with no findings. That is no guarantee of good rankings, but the basics are right.

site_noindex.titel: Website is excluded from the search index
site_noindex.titelMit: Website is excluded from the search index ({anzahl} pages affected)
site_noindex.hinweis: As long as the switch is on, nobody will find this website through a search engine.

keine_domain.hinweis: Without an address of your own there is no sitemap.xml, no robots.txt and no llms.txt.

seiten_ohne_titel.hinweis: The Meta title is the headline in the search result. If it is missing, Google takes some text from the page instead. Only published pages are counted. The "Pages" tab shows all pages, including drafts.

seiten_ohne_beschreibung.hinweis: The text below the title decides whether people click. Only published pages are counted. The "Pages" tab shows all pages, including drafts.

seiten_gleiche_beschreibung.hinweis: These pages do have a description — but all of them the same one. One of their own per page achieves considerably more. Only published pages are counted. The "Pages" tab shows all pages, including drafts.

doppelte_titel.titel: Pages with the same Meta title
doppelte_titel.titelMit: {anzahl} pages with the same Meta title
doppelte_titel.hinweis: Two pages with the same title compete for the same search query. Google reports this itself in the Search Console.

kein_firmenname.hinweis: Without a name in the company profile the website delivers no business details to Google — the switch under “Structured data” stays without effect.

keine_anschrift.hinweis: With an address Google can tie the business to a place and show it in local search.

kiExample.anrede: We use the formal 'Sie' and address the guest by their first and last name.
kiExample.laenge_ton: Two to three sentences, cordial, without advertising phrases.
kiExample.unterschrift_rolle: Always "Familie Jensen, Feriehus Kornblomst" — never just "The Team".
kiExample.lob_5_sterne: Briefly thank, pick up on a specific detail, invite to return.
kiExample.lob_4_sterne: Thank and explicitly address the point of criticism — do not ignore it.
kiExample.mittel_3_sterne: Factual, without justification: what we will change, what not and why.
kiExample.kritik_1_2_sterne: Remain calm, express regret, offer contact. Future readers are the audience.
kiExample.unwahre_kritik: Correct factually, without implying intent on the guest's part.
kiExample.gast_bewerten_haltung: 5 stars if handed over clean and registered as booked.
kiExample.niemals: No names of other guests, no amounts, no promise of refund.
